body.summary: In src/daemon/index.ts add the fire-and-forget pass next to the steering refresh (step 5b), far from the earlier guarded legacy-file move and leaving its anchors untouched: void runSchemaMigrations({ registeredRepos: async () => (await listRepos(db)).map(r => r.path) }).then(log the result).catch(log), never awaited, after the registry is loaded. A source-check test in schema-migrations.test.ts anchored the way the existing boot checks in repo-config.test.ts are.
acceptanceChecks: a source check shows src/daemon/index.ts calls runSchemaMigrations as a fire-and-forget pass after the registry loads, with a catch, and not awaited
the existing boot source checks in repo-config.test.ts still pass and daemon startup still logs ready
